April 18, 1936.

- 3 -

At 10 a.m. April 18 some sixty ex-workers assembled
in the Sales Office and demanded a satisfactory answer to
their demand. Despite the advice of their delegates
urging them to return home and wait for further information,
the ex-workers were still on the premises at 10.40 a.m.

Miscellaneous

Anti-Opium Movement - meeting to be held in
Chinese Chamber of Commerce

In connection with the anti-opium Movement, a meeting
will be held at 10 a.m. April 20 in the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce building, North Soochow Road. Local public
bodies, schools and Kuomintang branches have been instructed
by the local Tangpu to send representatives to attend the
meeting.

New Commander of local Paoantui assumes office

The Shanghai Municipality Peace Preservation Corps
(Paoantui) has been renamed "The Shanghai Municipality
Peace Preservation Group" (Paoantuan). Major General
Ki Chang-chien (吉章简), a former Regimental Commander
of the Military Police and newly appointed Commander of
the Group in succession to General Yang Hu, who was
appointed to the post of Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commander,
assumed office at 9.30 a.m. April 17 in the headquarters
at Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi.

Movements of Naval Vessels

The cruiser "Haichow" and the gunboat "Tehsung" left
Woosung for Nanking at 11 a.m. April 17.

- 3 -

4月18日上午10时，约六十名前工人在销售办事处集会，要求对其诉求给予满意答复。尽管其代表劝告他们回家等待进一步消息，但这些前工人直至上午10时40分仍滞留在该处。

杂项

禁烟运动——将在上海总商会举行会议

关于禁烟运动，将于4月20日上午10时在苏州北路上海总商会大楼举行会议。地方当局已指示各地方公共团体、学校及国民党分部派代表出席会议。

地方保安团新任指挥官就职

上海市保安团（Paoantui）已更名为“上海市保安总队”（Paoantuan）。吉章简（Ki Chang-chien）少将，原宪兵团长，继任杨虎将军出任总队长（杨虎已被任命为淞沪警备司令），于4月17日上午9时30分在吉斯西路旁丰林桥总部就职。

海军舰艇动向

巡洋舰“海筹”号及炮舰“德胜”号于4月17日上午11时离开吴淞前往南京。

April 17, 1936.
5
Afternoon Translation.
3648.
Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
THE DEPORTATION OF CHINESE
Owing to the weakness of our nation, Chinese people abroad are being discriminated against. Our Ministers and Consuls in foreign countries may open negotiations over this discrimination, but their efforts usually end in nothing.
According to information secured from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Bureau, 54 Chinese have been deported from Canada and 55 from Japan since this year.
It is understood that the Bureau is devising ways and means to render them relief.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:
GROUP OF EIGHT CHINESE RETURN FROM SOVIET RUSSIA
A number of Chinese who have been living in U.S.S.R. arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock on the morning of the 14th. Their names are: Yih Ching Sai (葉金山) (with his Russian wife and their son and daughter), Tsiang Tuh Tsai (德高) (also with a Russian wife), Yih Yoong Fee (葉雄飛) and Zung Kyi (陳記).
Yih Ching Sai together with his wife and children has been sent to his native place in Chekiang on the s.s. "Hai Ien" by the Shanghai Bureau of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission with the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company. The remaining four persons including the Russian wife of Tsiang Tuh Tsai are being temporarily accommodated in the Yoch Lai Lodging House in Nantao and will later be given positions in the Overseas Chinese Village.
A reporter of this paper learned from Tsiang Tuh Tsai that this group of eight persons left Moscow for Vladivostock at the beginning of last month. At Vladivostock they had to wait more than 20 days for a ship to Shanghai. Tsiang stated that 16 other Chinese who were unable to make the trip to China because of lack of funds have applied to the Chinese Embassy at Moscow for assistance. The reporter learned that Tsiang and the others who returned with him worked as hawkers in Russia. They had put aside a little money but it was taken away from them when they boarded the ship at Vladivostock, because according to law they were not allowed to carry Russian money out of that country. As a result they were destitute.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:
THE NEW CHIEF OF THE PEACE PRESERVATION GROUP
After General Yang Fu, the former Chief of the Peace Preservation Corps, was promoted Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner, the Peace Preservation Corps was reorganized into a Shanghai Peace Preservation Group.
It is understood that Mayor Wu Te Chen has appointed Chih Tsaung Chi (支掌機) as Chief of the Peace Preservation Group with Wen Hwa Seu (文華緒) as Deputy-Chief. Chih Tsaung Chi will assume office this morning.
△.3648

1936年4月17日。
5
下午译文。
3648.
《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：
华侨被遣返
由于国力衰弱，海外华人遭受歧视。我国驻外使节虽可就歧视问题进行交涉，但努力通常无果而终。
据从侨务委员会获得的消息，今年以来，已有54名华人从加拿大被遣返，55名从日本被遣返。
据悉，该委员会正在设法予以救济。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：
八名华人从苏俄回国
一批旅居苏联的华人于14日上午从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海。他们的姓名是：葉金山（Yih Ching Sai）（携其俄国妻子及一子一女）、德高（Tsiang Tuh Tsai）（亦携俄国妻子）、葉雄飛（Yih Yoong Fee）和陈記（Zung Kyi）。
葉金山及其妻儿已由侨务委员会上海办事处通过招商局轮船公司安排，乘“海晏”轮送往浙江原籍。其余四人，包括德高的俄国妻子，暂时安置在南市育莱旅社，随后将在华侨村安排职位。
本报记者向德高获悉，这八人于上月初离开莫斯科前往符拉迪沃斯托克。在符拉迪沃斯托克，他们等待赴沪船只超过20天。德高称，另有16名华人因缺乏资金无法回国，已向中国驻莫斯科大使馆申请援助。记者获悉，德高及同行者在俄国从事小贩工作。他们积蓄了一点钱，但在符拉迪沃斯托克登船时被没收，因为根据法律，他们不得携带俄国货币出境。结果他们身无分文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：
保安总队新队长
原保安总团主任杨虎将军晋升为淞沪警备司令后，保安总团改组为上海保安总队。
据悉，市长吴铁城已任命支掌機（Chih Tsaung Chi）为保安总队主任，文華緒（Wen Hwa Seu）为副主任。支掌機将于今晨就职。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3648
Date 18, 3, 35.
March 18, 1935.

Military

Movement of Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps
The 3rd Battalion (450 strong), 6th Regiment of the
Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps arrived at Nantao Bund
for Haimen by the s.s. "Chusan" at 6 a.m. March 17 and
left for Hangchow at 9.50 a.m.

Military Uniforms for Yunnan
The 10,000 uniforms for the troops under the command
of General Loong Yung (龍雲), Chairman of Yunnan
Provincial Government, which arrived here from Nanking on
March 15, were shipped to Kwangtung by the s.s. "An Shing"
at 5 p.m. March 17, en route to Yunnan.

S. B. REGISTRY.
编号 D 3648
日期 1935年3月18日。
1935年3月18日。

军事

浙江保安队的调动
浙江保安队第六团第三营（450人）于3月17日上午6时乘“舟山”轮抵达南市外滩前往海门，并于上午9时50分启程前往杭州。

云南军用制服
云南省政府主席龙云 (Loong Yung) 将军麾下部队所需的10,000套制服，于3月15日从南京运抵此处，随后于3月17日下午5时由“安兴”轮 (s.s. "An Shing") 装船运往广东，途中转往云南。

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3648
13 / 3 / 35

March 13, 1935.

Political (4)

North Eastern Problems Research Society

The office of the North Eastern Problems Research
Society was on March 10 removed from 375 Route Willon to
Lane 166, No.4 Rue Tenant de la Tour.

Cotton Mill Owners Association - members to reduce
working expenditure

Thirteen members of the Chinese Cotton Mill Owners'
Association at a tiffin held in their office at 260 Avenue
Edward VII on March 12 decided to urge all members to reduce
the overhead charges of their plants in order to maintain
operations.

D5354.
Opposition to increase in telephone rates

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce on March 12, sent
a letter to the S.M.C. requesting it not to approve the
increase in the telephone rate.

..........

Military

D3648.
Movement of Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps

80 men of the Machine Gun Company, 1st Battalion,
6th Regiment of the Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps,
arrived at Shanghai South Station from Hangchow at
8 a.m. March 12 and left Nantao Bund for Taichow, Chekiang,
by the s.s. "Tah Shing" at 5 p.m. the same day.

1935年3月13日。

政治 (4)

东北问题研究会

东北问题研究会办公室于3月10日从威伦路 (Route Willon) 375号迁至丹徒路 (Rue Tenant de la Tour) 4号166弄。

棉纺业同业公会 - 会员削减运营开支

3月12日，中国棉纺业同业公会十三名会员在爱多亚路260号该会办公室举行的午餐会上决定，敦促所有会员削减工厂的管理费用，以维持运营。

D5354.
反对提高电话费率

上海总商会于3月12日致函工部局，请求其不要批准提高电话费率。

..........

浙江保安队的调动

浙江保安队第六团第一营机枪连80人，于3月12日上午8时从杭州抵达上海南站，并于当日下午5时乘“大生”轮 (s.s. "Tah Shing") 离开南市外滩前往浙江台州。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. R. REGISTRY.
No. D. 3648
Date 2. 3. 1935

March 2, 1935.

Military

Munitions - sent from Kiangnan Arsenal to Nanking
Six small calibre guns, 2,000 shells for same and
1,680 rifles, hitherto stored in the Kiangnan Arsenal,
Kaochongmiso, were sent to Nanking by rail at 9.15 a.m.
March 1.

Wounded and Disbanded soldiers - arrive in Shanghai
Some 200 wounded soldiers formerly accommodated in
the Field Hospital of National Troops engaged in bandit-
suppression in Fokien, arrived at Nantao Bund by the S.S.
"Fu Loong" at 1 p.m. March 1 and will leave for Nanking
by the same vessel on March 2 for the purpose of receiving
medical treatment in hospitals there.
Some 150 disbanded soldiers of the 9th, 80th and 83rd
Divisions in Fokien, who arrived in Shanghai by the same
steamer, dispersed on their arrival.

（批：D3648）
Trained recruits for Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps
arrive at Shanghai
Some 160 recruits who have received the necessary
course of training at the Hangchow Training Depot, arrived
at Shanghai by rail at 9.30 a.m. March 1. They are now
at Shanghai South Station pending ship accommodation to
Wenchow where they will join the 1st Regiment of the
Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别注册科 (S. R. REGISTRY)
编号 D. 3648
日期 1935年3月2日

1935年3月2日。

军事

军火——从江南兵工厂运往南京
六门小口径火炮、2000发配套炮弹以及
1680支步枪，此前储存在高昌庙江南兵工厂，
于3月1日上午9时15分由铁路运往南京。

伤兵及遣散士兵——抵达上海
约200名前在福建从事剿匪行动的国军野战医院收治的伤兵，
于3月1日下午1时乘“福隆”轮 (S.S. "Fu Loong") 抵达南市外滩，
并将于3月2日乘同一艘轮船前往南京，以便在当地医院接受治疗。
约150名来自福建的第9师、第80师和第83师的遣散士兵，
乘同一艘轮船抵达上海后，在到达时即行离散。

（批注：D3648）
浙江保安总队受训新兵抵达上海
约160名在杭州训练所完成必要课程的新兵，
于3月1日上午9时30分乘火车抵达上海。他们目前
在上海南站等候船只，将前往温州加入
浙江保安总队第1团。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRI
No. D 3648
at 12. 3p.

February 14, 1935.

Military

Aged and Unfit soldiers - en route from Fokien to Nanking
Some three hundred unfit and aged soldiers of
the 49th, 78th and 88th Divisions of the Eastern
Route (Fokien) Field Headquarters arrived at Pootung
from Fokien on February 12, 1935, and were repatriated to
Nanking by train at 11 p.m. February 13. Each of them,
it is learned, was given 20 cents before departure by a
representative of the Bureau of Social Affairs.

Movement of Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps
D3648 The 3rd Company (some 120 strong), 1st Battalion
6th Regiment of the Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps,
which arrived here on February 3 (Vide I.R. 13/2/35),
left the South Station for Hangchow at 10 a.m. February 13.

Artillery en route from Fokien to Ichang
At 10 a.m. February 13, some 500 troops of the Artillery
Battalion of the 4th Division, together with 7 small
calibre guns, 3 mountain guns, and 6 "Stokes" guns, in
addition to military accoutrements, arrived at Nantao Bund
by the s.s. "Yuan An" and left by the same boat for Ichang
at 6 a.m. February 14.
Some 90 disbanded soldiers of the Eastern Route
(Fokien) Field Headquarters arrived on the same boat from
Fokien. Of this number, fifty disembarked on arrival
here, while the remaining forty continued on to Ichang.

1935年2月14日。

军事

老弱士兵——从福建前往南京途中
东路（福建）野战司令部第49师、第78师和第88师的
约三百名老弱不适役士兵，
于1935年2月12日从福建抵达浦东，并于2月13日晚上11时
乘火车被遣返回南京。据悉，他们在出发前每人
从社会局代表处领取了2角钱。

浙江保安总队调动
D3648 浙江保安总队第6团第1营第3连（约120人），
该部于2月3日抵达此地（参见情报报告 1935年2月13日），
于2月13日上午10时离开南站前往杭州。

炮兵——从福建前往宜昌途中
2月13日上午10时，第4师炮兵营约500名士兵，
连同7门小口径火炮、3门山炮和6门“斯托克斯”迫击炮，
以及军用装备，乘“元安”轮 (s.s. "Yuan An") 抵达南市外滩，
并于2月14日上午6时乘同一艘船离开前往宜昌。
东路（福建）野战司令部的约90名遣散士兵
乘同一艘船从福建抵达。其中五十人在抵达此处时上岸，
其余四十人继续前往宜昌。

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3648
13. 1 2. 135

Political (4) February 13, 1935.

A meeting of the committee in question was scheduled
to be held on February 12 for the purpose of discussing
the increase in telephone charges but owing to the
differences in opinion, proved abortive. Yih Kai-shing's
opponents submitted a proposal that all military or
quasi-military men should be excluded from participation
in Citizens' movements (Yih Kai-shing is Chief of the
Shanghai Office of the 26th Division of the Nationalist
Army and once used his military status to escape the
jurisdiction of the Court (Hsu Ngoeh-ying Case - Vide I.R.
5/4/34). Yih and his supporters retaliated by demanding
an audit of the accounts of the funeral affairs of the
'patriot' Pan Hung Sung. The meeting thereupon broke
up in disorder.

Military

Movement of Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps

The 3rd Company (some 120 strong), 1st Battalion,
6th Regiment of the Chekiang Peace Preservation,
stationed in Taichow, arrived at Nantao Bund from Haimen
by the s.s. "Mou Lee" at 8 a.m. February 13. They
subsequently proceeded to Shanghai South Station and
remain there pending transportation to Hangchow.

政治 (4) 1935年2月13日。

有关委员会原定于2月12日举行会议，讨论电话费上涨问题，
但因意见分歧，会议未能成功举行。易凯兴 (Yih Kai-shing) 的反对者提交了一项提案，
要求将所有军人或准军事人员排除在市民运动之外
（易凯兴是国民党陆军第26师上海办事处主任，
曾利用其军人身份逃避法院管辖权（徐鄂英案——参见情报报告 1934年4月5日）。
易及其支持者则通过要求审计“爱国者”潘洪松 (Pan Hung Sung) 丧事账目进行反击。
会议随即在混乱中解散。

军事

浙江保安总队调动

驻台州的浙江保安总队第6团第1营第3连（约120人），
于2月13日上午8时乘“茂利”轮 (s.s. "Mou Lee") 从海门抵达南市外滩。
随后他们前往上海南站，并在那里等候交通工具前往杭州。

Movement of Notables
From Nanking
Arrived at Chenju at 2.30 p.m. November 21:-
Koo Meng Yu, Minister of Railways.
Arrived at 7.40 a.m. November 22:
H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance.

Departed at 11 p.m. November 21:-
Yu Yeu Jen, President of Supervisory Yuan.
Lieu Vung Hao, Ambassador to Italy.
Wu Tieh Chen, Mayor of Greater Shanghai.
Tan Tatang, Vice President of the Legislative Yuan.
Fu Jul Ling, member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang.
Pei Yuin Ti, -do-
Ma Tsao Tsiing, -do-

Special Kuomintang of the Paotui - telegraphs to
Gen. Chiang re Bandit Suppression Campaign
The Special Kuomintang Headquarters of the Paotui
despatched a telegram on November 21 to Gen. Chiang
congratulating him on his success in the bandit
suppression campaign and urging him to continue his
efforts in order to eliminate such lawlessness in China.

Shanghai People's Military Training Committee -
convenes meeting of military instructors of local schools
In answer to the summons of the People's Military
Training Committee, some 30 military instructors of
various local universities, colleges and middle schools
assembled in the office of the body, Dah Chih Road,
Nantao, at 4.30 p.m. November 21. Tsiao Tsih Hwa (焦續華).

October 18, 4.

Military

D.3648
Paoantui in Chapei - instal military telephone wires
The 1st Regiment of the local Peace Preservation Corps, with Headquarters in the Police Training Depot, 250 Kung Woo Road, Ch'pei, is now installing four military telephone wires, one from the Headquarters to Shanghai North Station, one to Chenju Railway Station, one to Nanziang Railway Station and another to Hwangtu Railway Station, in order to facilitate communications between headquarters and the men stationed at these places. The work is expected to be completed in four days' time.

Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps - cotton padded uniforms arrive at Shanghai en route to Teishun, Chekiang
1,000 suits of cotton padded uniforms for the 1st Regiment of the Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps, stationed at Teishun, Chekiang, arrived at Shanghai South Railway Station from Hangchow at 10 a.m. October 17 and are now stored there pending transportation to their destination.

Movement of Naval Ships
The gunboat "Kienkong" arrived at Kaochongmiao from Tungchow at 10 a.m. October 17.
The small gunboat "Kyungsing" left Kaochongmiao for Woosung at 9 a.m. October 17.

本地保安团第一团，团部设在闸北共和路250号警察训练所，目前正在架设四条军用电话线，一条从团部至上海北站，一条至真如火车站，一条至南翔火车站，另一条至黄渡火车站，以便团部与驻扎在这些地方的部队进行联络。预计该项工作将在四天内完成。

No. D 3648
Date 7 / 8 / 34）

August 6-7, 1934.

Military

（批：D. 3648）
Paotantui in Chapei - re-organized

In compliance with the instruction of Gen. Yang Hu, com-mander-in-chief of the Peace Preservation Corps, the 1st Regiment of the Corps, stationed in Chapei has been recently re-organized. Under the new scheme each battalion consists of only three companies instead of four as previously. The surplus men have either been absorbed by other sections or assigned for duty at the Headquarters of the Regiment.

Recruits - leave for Hangchow

30 recruits for the Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps left Shanghai South Railway Station for Hanghow at 9.55 a.m. August 6. These men were recruited in Nantao by the Recruiting Office of the Corps in the Coal and Charcoal Merchants' Guild, Foh Yeu Road, City.

Troops from Hankow to Fukien

The 294th Regiment of the 49th Division arrived at the Peh Piao Wharf, Shih Hwei Kang, near Kaochongmiao, between 1 p.m. and 5 p.m. August 6 on the following six steamers:-
S.S. "Kiangtien", S.S. "Kiang Yua", S.S. "Fu Yang",
S.S. "Wan Hsiang", S.S. "Doong Hwa" and S.S. "Tsing Pu".

The Regiment which is en route from Hankow to Fukien is 2,000 strong and has with it, in addition to equipment, ten mountain guns and twenty machine guns.

These troops are now billeted in the Coal Godown at the Wharf, pending transportation to their destination.

1934年8月6-7日。

军事

（批：D. 3648）
闸北保安队——重组

遵照和平保全团总指挥杨虎将军的指令，驻守闸北的该团第1团近期已进行重组。根据新编制，每营仅辖三个连，而非此前的四个连。多余人员已被其他部门吸收或分配至团部服役。

新兵——前往杭州

浙江和平保全团的30名新兵于8月6日上午9时55分从上海南站出发前往杭州。这些人员由该团招募处于南市法租界华界交界处的佛佑路煤业公会招募。

部队从汉口开往福建

第49师第294团于8月6日下午1时至5时之间，乘坐以下六艘轮船抵达高昌庙附近石惠港北票码头：
“江天”轮、“江源”轮、“富阳”轮、
“万祥”轮、“东华”轮和“清浦”轮。

该团正从汉口开往福建，全团人数为2,000人，除装备外，还配有山炮10门和机枪20挺。

在等待运往目的地期间，这些部队目前驻扎在码头的煤炭仓库内。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No D 3648
Date 13 / 3 / 34

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, JUNE 1, 1932

CHARGES AGAINST
SPECIAL POLICE
Ex-Employees Of Japan-
ese In Chapei Said To
Be Mistreated

It has been revealed to Japan-
ese authorities that the Chinese
special police, now on duty in
Chapei and adjoining areas, are
mistreating local Chinese inhabit-
ants on the ground that they had
worked for Japanese military
officials. A number of such inno-
cent Chinese are said to have been
arrested and locked up by these
police, who are branding the
arrested men as "traitors."

Japanese officials and residents
here are indignant at the fact that
Chinese gangsters and others in
Chapei and elsewhere, garrisoned
by the Japanese until recently,
have desecrated various places
where had stood wooden tablets or
stones marking the spots where
Japanese officers and men fell
during the Sino-Japanese engage-
ments. These tablets or tombstones
have been pulled up and the spots
otherwise desecrated. The wooden
tablets have either been used as
firewood or simply destroyed.

No Chinese tombstone in the
areas garrisoned by the Japanese
until recently has ever been pulled
up or otherwise destroyed by
Japanese naval or military officers
or men, and the acts of the Chin-
ese, therefore, are arousing deep
indignation among the Japanese.
—Press Union.

《字林西报》，1932年6月1日，星期三

针对
特别警察的指控
据称闸北前日本雇员
遭受虐待

据向日本当局透露，目前在闸北及周边地区执勤的中国特别警察，以当地中国居民曾为日本军官工作为由，对他们进行虐待。据说许多无辜的中国人被这些警察逮捕并关押，这些警察将被捕者标榜为“汉奸”。

日本的官员和侨民对以下事实感到愤慨：在闸北及其他直到最近仍由日军驻守的地区，中国帮派分子和其他人亵渎了多处立有木牌或石碑的地方，这些木牌或石碑标记着中日交战期间日本官兵阵亡的地点。这些木牌或墓碑被拔起，地点也遭到其他形式的亵渎。木牌要么被当作柴火，要么被直接销毁。

在直到最近仍由日军驻守的地区，从未发生过日本海军或陆军官兵拔起或破坏中国墓碑的情况，因此中国人的行为在日本人中引起了强烈的愤慨。
——联合通讯社。

January 8.

Military

D.3648 Movement of Pasentui

Some fifty nine members of the 1st Regiment of the
Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps, stationed at Wenchow, passed
through Shanghai between 6 a.m. and 7.40 a.m. January 8 en
route to Hangchow. They arrived at the Kyung Lee Yuan
Wharf, French Bund, by the s.s. "Kia-wo" and left Shanghai
South by rail. It is learned that they will undergo
a course of training at Hangchow.

Movement of Naval Ships

The Coastal Defence Gunboat "Hai-ou" arrived at
Kaochongmiao from the Chekiang-Fekien border coast
at 4 p.m. January 6.

The Gunboat "Kiangyuan" left Kaochongmiao for
Wenchow at 3 p.m. January 6.

The Gunboat "Chungan" left Kaochongmiao for the
Chekiang-Fekien border coast at 8 p.m. January 6.
It carried a sum of $200,000 for the pay of men of
naval ships cruising off the Chekiang-Fekien coast.

The Gunboat "Ninghai" and the Training Cruiser
"Yingrui" arrived at Woosung at 3 p.m. January 6 from
the Chekiang-Fekien coast.

D.3648 保安队调动

浙江和平保全团第1团约59名成员，原驻温州，于1月8日上午6时至7时40分之间途经上海前往杭州。他们乘坐“嘉禾”轮抵达法租界外滩金利源码头，随后经铁路离开上海南站。据悉，他们将在杭州接受训练课程。

军舰调动

海防炮舰“海鸥”号于1月6日下午4时从浙闽沿海边界抵达高昌庙。

炮舰“江元”号于1月6日下午3时离开高昌庙前往温州。

炮舰“崇安”号于1月6日晚上8时离开高昌庙前往浙闽沿海边界。该舰携带20万美元，用于支付在浙闽沿海巡航的海军舰艇人员的薪饷。

炮舰“宁海”号和练习巡洋舰“应瑞”号于1月6日下午3时从浙闽沿海抵达吴淞。

Date 3 / 12 / 33

December 3, 1933.    Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

PRINCE RAJAH SINGH ENTERTAINED

Prince Rajah Singh of Nepal gave an address
on the evening of December 1 at the Chinese Y.M.C.A.,
Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession. The subject
of his address was "Humanity and the peace of the world."
Prince Rajah Singh was invited yesterday
to a tiffin party by Mr. Chang Min (張), former
Special Envoy to Nepal, at the Oriental Hotel, Nanking
Road.
In the course of the function, Prince Rajah
Singh said that he regretted the rebellion in Fukien
and that he would send a telegram to President Wang
Ching-wei and General Chiang Kai-shek requesting permission
to allow him to proceed to Fukien to advise Chen Min-
shu, Li Chi-shen and others involved in the uprising.
Prince Rajah Singh concluded by saying that
if the permission was not granted, he would go to the
battle field and place himself between the lines of
the opposing sides to show his willingness to sacrifice
himself in the cause of peace and the unity
of China.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

ANTI-CIVIL WAR LEAGUE

Yesterday at 2 p.m. a meeting of the Anti-
civil War League took place at the Bankers' Association,
4 Hongkong Road. The chair was taken by Mr. Lin Keng-
hou and many members including Wang Shiao-lai, Tu Yuh-
sun and Chen Lih-Ding attended. As no reply was received
from Generals Tsai Ting-kai and Chiang Kwang-nai, it
was decided at the meeting to despatch a telegram
to them, reminding them of the advice in the first
telegram and warning them of the consequences of their
rebellion.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PEACE PRESERVATION CORPS ON PARADE

A parade of the Peace Preservation Corps
took place at 12.30 a.m. yesterday at the Lunghwa
Aerodrome, Nantao. About 2000 members of the Corps
under the command of General Yang Hu, Commander of the
Corps, were inspected by Mayor Wu Te-chen. A sham
battle was staged in which rifles, machine guns, trench
mortars and other weapons were used.

D 3648

1933年12月3日。 晨间译文

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

拉贾·辛格王子受款待

尼泊尔拉贾·辛格王子于12月1日晚在法租界蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）基督教青年会发表演讲。演讲主题为“人道与世界和平”。
昨日，前驻尼泊尔特使张敏先生（Mr. Chang Min (張)）在南京路东方饭店设午宴招待拉贾·辛格王子。
席间，拉贾·辛格王子表示对福建叛乱感到遗憾，并称将致电汪精卫主席和蒋介石将军，请求准许他前往福建，向陈铭枢、李济深及其他参与起义者提供建议。
拉贾·辛格王子最后表示，如果未获准许，他将奔赴战场，置身于交战双方阵线之间，以表明他为和平与中国统一事业牺牲自我的意愿。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

反内战联盟

昨日下午2时，反内战联盟在香港路4号银行公会举行会议。林庚侯先生担任主席，王孝来、杜月笙、陈立定等众多成员出席。由于未收到蔡廷锴将军和蒋光鼐将军的回复，会议决定向他们发出电报，重申第一封电报中的劝告，并警告其叛乱的后果。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

保卫团阅兵

昨日上午12时30分，保卫团在南市龙华机场举行阅兵。约2000名保卫团成员在总指挥杨虎将军的率领下，接受吴铁城市长的检阅。随后举行了使用步枪、机枪、战壕迫击炮及其他武器的模拟战斗演习。

D 3648

December 2, 1933.
Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers:

PEACE PRESERVATION CORPS PARADE TO-DAY

General Yang Hu (楊虎), Commander of the
Peace Preservation Corps has decided to hold a parade
of the Corps at 9 a.m. this morning at the Lung Hwa
Aerodrome, Nantao.

The parade will be inspected by Mayor Wu
Te-chen, Garrison Commissioner of the Shanghai-Woosung
Area. Commissioners of the various Bureaux of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai and leading officers
of public organizations have all been invited to attend
the parade.

（批：A 3648）

No. D 3648
December Date 2 / 12 / 33

Military

Passage of Paontui through Shanghai
One hundred and fifty recruits for the Chekiang
Provincial Peace Preservation Corps, who have finished
a course of training at Hangchow, passed through
Shanghai on December 1 to join the 6th Regiment of
the Corps stationed at Taichow. These men arrived
at Shanghai South by rail at 1.15 p.m. and left
Nantao Bund by the s.s. "Dah Hwa" at 5.30 p.m.

Military equipment - sent to Wenchow
The uniforms, thermos bottles, etc. for the
Chekiang Peace Preservation Corps at Wenchow which
arrived at Shanghai on November 29 (Vide I.R. 30/11/33) were
shipped to their destination by the s.s. "San Kiang" of
the Dah Ching Steamship Navigation Co. from the Nantao
Bund at 6.30 p.m. December 1.

Paontui - review at Aerodrome to-day
The local Peace Preservation Corps will be
reviewed at 9 a.m. to-day, December 2 at the Lunghwa
Aerodrome when Mayor Wu Tieh Chen and General Yang Hu
will be present.

（批：D 3648）

浙江省保安团150名新兵在杭州完成训练课程后，于12月1日途经上海，前往加入驻扎在台州的该团第6团。这些人于下午1时15分乘火车抵达上海南站，并于下午5时30分从南市外滩乘坐“大华”轮离开。

军用装备——运往温州
11月29日抵达上海的温州浙江保安团制服、热水瓶等物资（参见1933年11月30日情报报告），于12月1日下午6时30分由大清轮船公司的“三江”轮从南市外滩运往目的地。

保安团——今日机场检阅
本地保安团将于今日（12月2日）上午9时在龙华机场接受检阅，吴铁城市长和杨虎将军将出席。

August 30, 1933.
Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

The Shun Pao: China Times:-

AUTUMN DRILL OF PEACE PRESERVATION CORPS

D 3648
The Control Committee of the Peace Preservation Corps yesterday ordered the Corps to prepare for the autumn drill to be commenced from September 1. This drill will last for three months.
On October 10, Mayor Wu Te Chen will review the entire Corps and a prize distribution ceremony will be held on the same day.

The China Times:-

INSPECTION OF WEIGHTS AND MEASURES IN FRENCH CONCESSION

D 3648
The local Weights and Measures Inspection Department commenced the inspection of weights and measures in the French Concession on August 28 in connection with the enforcement of the new system.
The inspection will be completed in one or two days.

The China Times:-

CHINESE MUNICIPALITY TO COLLECT LAND TAX

The collection of land tax by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai is being opposed by land-owners.
According to an important official of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the collection must be made.
The rate of the tax in Chinese territory is far lower than that in the Settlements. The Municipality commenced the collection from August 1.

The China Times:-

SUN FO'S MOTHER LEAVES FOR HONGKONG

Madame Lu, mother of Mr. Sun Fo, chairman of the Legislative Yuan, will leave for Hongkong with her daughter-in-law, Mrs. Sun Fo, at 6 a.m. to-day by the S.S. President Jefferson.
Yu Min, chief of the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, has been instructed by Sun Fo to proceed to Canton on the same steamer to undertake certain negotiations with the Canton Government.
Chao Te Chang will act as Chief of the Department during the absence of Yu

1933年8月30日。
晨间译文

杂项

《申报》；《时事新报》：-

保安团秋季演习

D 3648
保安团管理委员会昨日下令该团准备自9月1日开始的秋季演习。此次演习将持续三个月。
10月10日，市长吴铁城将检阅全团，并于同日举行颁奖仪式。

《时事新报》：-

法租界度量衡检查

D 3648
地方度量衡检查局于8月28日开始在法租界进行度量衡检查，以配合新制度的实施。
检查工作将在一两天内完成。

《时事新报》：-

上海市政府征收土地税

大上海市政府征收土地税之举遭到地主反对。
据大上海市政府一位重要官员称，征税必须进行。
华界的税率远低于租界。市政府自8月1日开始征收。

《时事新报》：-

孙科之母赴港

立法院院长孙科先生之母陆夫人，将于今日上午6时与其儿媳孙夫人乘“杰斐逊总统”轮前往香港。
外交部上海办事处主任俞敏奉孙科之命，将乘同一艘轮船前往广州，与广东政府进行某些谈判。
赵德章将在俞敏缺席期间代理部主任职务。

August 22, 1933. Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE PEACE MAINTENANCE CORPS.

At 4 p.m. yesterday, the Peace Maintenance Corps
Control Committee held an emergency meeting to discuss the
case of Yang Chen Shing (楊仁馨), Captain of the Second
Squadron Peace Maintenance Corps in Pangpu District, who
has declined to hand over his command.

The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a time limit be given to Yang Chen
Shing to hand over his command by August 25.
2) That Captain Yang be considered as having
resigned from his post.
3) That one of the Vice-Captains of the Second
Squadron Peace Maintenance Corps in Bangpu District be
appointed to take charge of the Squadron for the time
being.

At 9 a.m. yesterday, the entire body of men of
the Second Squadron Peace Maintenance Corps in Bangpu
District submitted a demand to the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai that the order discharging Yang Chen Shing from
the post of Captain of the 2nd Squadron Peace Maintenance
Corps be withdrawn.

Mr. O.K. Yue, Chief-Secretary of the Municipality
who received them, promised to deal with the matter
according to law.

D 3648

1933年8月22日。下午译文

杂项

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

保安团事务。

昨日下午4时，保安团管理委员会召开紧急会议，讨论彭浦区保安团第二大队队长杨仁馨拒绝移交指挥权一案。

通过以下决议：-
1) 限定杨仁馨于8月25日前移交指挥权。
2) 视杨队长为已辞职。
3) 任命彭浦区保安团第二大队副队长之一暂时负责该大队事务。

昨日上午9时，彭浦区保安团第二大队全体队员向大上海市政府提交请愿书，要求撤销解除杨仁馨保安团第二大队队长职务的命令。

接待他们的市政府秘书长岳开先先生承诺将依法处理此事。

D 3648

August

Miscellaneous (2)

Merchant Volunteers - efforts of Authorities
to induce Pangpu section commander to vacate
his post

Seven members of the Shanghai Municipality
Merchant Volunteer Corps Control Committee held a
meeting in their office at 1 Jao Ka Pang, City,
between 4.15 and 5.45 p.m. August 21 and discussed
the refusal of the commander of the 2nd Section
Office of the Pangpu District to vacate his post.
The following resolutions were passed :-

1. That Yang Jen-shing (楊仁馨), Commander of the
2nd Section Office be instructed to give up his
post not later than August 31.

2. That the order for his dismissal be rescinded in
order to give him an opportunity of tendering his
resignation.

3. That pending the return of Yang Jen-shing from
Hangchow, the Vice Commander be instructed to
take charge of the office.

At 9 a.m. August 21, about 100 members of the
2nd Section Office of the Pangpu District called at the
Shanghai Municipality at 9 a.m. August 21 and applied
for rescission of the order dismissing Yang Jen-shing
from his post as commander of the 2nd Section Office
of the Pangpu District. They were promised that their
request would be recorded and the matter would receive
careful attention.

商团——当局劝诱彭浦区指挥官离职的努力

Date 19 / 8 / 33

Military

Recruits
Twenty recruits enlisted at Taichow for the 3rd
Division arrived at Nantao Bund by the s.s. "Taichow"
at 5 a.m. August 18. They subsequently proceeded to
the Recruits Transportation Office, Kwang Foh Sz
Temple on Fang Pang Road, City, and left Shanghai
South for Hangchow by train at 4.20 p.m. the same day.
Another batch of 11 recruits enlisted at Wenchow
for the 88th Division who arrived at French Bund by
the s.s. "Chiyien" at 2.30 p.m. August 17, left
Shanghai South for Hangchow by the 10.10 a.m. train
on August 18.

Movement of Paramilitary
D 3648
The 24 soldiers attached to the 1st Battalion of
the 5th Regiment of the Chekiang Peace Preservation
Corps at Taichow who escorted 14 bandits and a
consignment of munitions to Hangchow (Vide I.R. 18/8/33)
arrived at Shanghai South at 1.05 p.m. August 18, and
left Nantao Bund for Taichow at 4.30 p.m. the same day
by the s.s. "Dih Hwa".

新兵
8月18日凌晨5时，二十名在台州为第三师招募的新兵乘“台州”轮抵达南市外滩。随后他们前往市内方浜路广福寺新兵转运处，并于同日下午4时20分由上海南站乘火车前往杭州。
另一批11名在温州为第八十八师招募的新兵，于8月17日下午2时30分乘“济远”轮抵达法外滩，于8月18日上午10时10分由上海南站乘火车前往杭州。

准军事部队调动
D 3648
浙江省保安团第五团第一营所属24名士兵，驻防台州，曾押送14名匪徒及一批军火前往杭州（见1933年8月18日情报报告），于8月18日下午1时05分抵达上海南站，并于同日下午4时30分乘“德华”轮由南市外滩返回台州。

Military

Training Institute of Paontui - formed

A Training Institute for the purpose of organizing
a Training Company of the Peace Preservation Corps
otherwise known as Paontui was inaugurated at 9.30 a.m.
July 20 on the premises formerly used by the Lunghwa
Branch of the Kiangnan Arsenal, Lunghwa when Mayor
Wu Tieh-chen, General Yang Hu, Commander of the Corps
and about 40 representatives of Chinese Authorities were
present. The function lasted about an hour. There
are now 150 cadets who have been selected from various
units of the Paontui and the training will last three
months.

Recruits

53 recruits enlisted in Nantao and Pootung for the
88th Division left Shanghai South for Hangchow by train
at 4.20 p.m. July 20.

Movement of Naval Ships

The Transport "Tingan" arrived at Kaochongmiao
from Nanking at 7 a.m. July 20.
The Gunboat "Chungsan" arrived at Kaochongmiao
from Woosung at 8 a.m. July 20.
The Gunboat "Yih-sien" left Kaochongmiao for
Nanking at 10 a.m. July 20.

（批：D3648）

军事

保安团训练所成立

旨在组建一支保安团（又称保团）训练连的训练所，于7月20日上午9时30分在龙华江南兵工厂龙华分厂原址正式成立，吴铁城市长、杨虎将军（保安团指挥官）以及约40名中国当局代表出席。仪式持续约一小时。现有150名学员，系从保团各单位选拔而来，训练期为三个月。

新兵

为第88师招募的53名新兵，于7月20日下午4时20分乘火车从上海南站前往杭州，这些新兵在南市和浦东招募。

海军舰艇调动

运输舰“定安”号于7月20日上午7时从南京抵达高昌庙。
炮舰“中山”号于7月20日上午8时从吴淞抵达高昌庙。
炮舰“义先”号于7月20日上午10时离开高昌庙前往南京。

（批：D3648）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
D 3648
March 13 33.

Dear Warren,

With reference to your inquiry, the two
armed Chinese on duty opposite Jessfield Park are
guarding No.947 Brenan Road, the Central Research
Institute, where Chinese products intended for
exhibition at the Chicago Fair are at present on
exhibition. These armed men belong to a party
of thirty members of the Baoantui (Peace Preservation
Corps) who have been lent by General Yang Hu to
protect the exhibits at the exhibition. They will
soon be withdrawn.

Yours sincerely,

Captain C.P. Warren,
Brigade Major,
Yu Yuen Road Camp.

1933年3月13日。

亲爱的沃伦：

关于你的查询，在极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）对面执勤的两名武装中国人正在守卫布伦南路947号的中央研究院，那里目前正在展出拟参加芝加哥博览会的中国产品。这些武装人员属于一支由三十人组成的保安团（Peace Preservation Corps）队伍，该队伍是由杨虎将军借调来保护展览品的。他们很快将被撤走。

此致

敬礼

C.P. 沃伦上尉，
营副官，
愚园路营地。

December 28, 1932.

Public Sale of Opium in Shanghai.

"The Special Service Department" of the Pasentui, the controlling organ of the opium monopoly in Chinese controlled territory was in the middle of December annexed and incorporated en bloc into the Bureau of Public Safety in accordance with the instructions of Mayor Yu To-chen.

This step was taken by the Mayor it is reported in order to facilitate his control over the drug combine as Wen Hung En, the Chief of the Bureau, is a follower of his, while Yang Hu (楊虎), the Commander of the local Paountui, is a nominee of Tu Yueh Sung and not under the influence of the Mayor.

So far no protest against this change has been forthcoming from Yang Hu and it is thought that he is waiting until the Spring of 1933 when the Pasentui will have been enlarged by the addition of two regiments, permission for the organization of which as well as the supply of arms and ammunition had been promised by General Chiang Kai-shek through the Military Committee of the National Government.

The Chief of the "Special Tax Bureau of the Whole Province of Kiangsu" (江蘇全省特稅局) located at Chinkiang which controls the opium monopoly in Kiangsu is one Lee Tuh Yung (盧夢) alias Lee Ying Min (盧映明), native of Fukien and ex-Commissioner of Finance of the Hupeh Provincial Government. The original plan to appoint the Commissioner of Finance concurrently to this post has not been adhered to.
pages.zh:
1932年12月28日。

上海鸦片公卖。

中国控制区内鸦片垄断的管理机构——保安团的“特务处”，于12月中旬根据市长虞洽卿的指示，被整体 annexed 并入公安局。

据报道，市长采取这一举措是为了便于他控制毒品集团，因为局局长温洪恩是他的追随者，而当地保安团司令杨虎（楊虎）则是杜月笙提名的人选，不受市长的影响。

截至目前，杨虎尚未对此变更提出抗议，据信他正在等待1933年春季，届时保安团将通过增加两个团而扩大，蒋介石将军已通过国民政府军事委员会承诺批准组建这两个团并提供武器弹药。

位于镇江、控制江苏省鸦片垄断的“江苏省全省特税局”局长是卢梦（Lee Tuh Yung），别名卢映明（Lee Ying Min），福建人，前湖北省政府财政厅长。原计划由财政厅长兼任此职的方案并未执行。

NORTH CHINA DAILY MAIL
FRIDAY SEPTEMBER 16th, 1932.

Correspondence
WHAT IS GAMBLING?

The recent gambling raid in Racecourse Road seems to have created quite a stir in Tientsin, especially among the foreign community, many of whom maintain that the raid was not warranted and that the establishment in question was merely a private club where members adjourned for a quiet little game of poker.

The gambling laws are both complicated and elastic, not only in China but in other countries as well, especially Great Britain. In the latter country sweepstakes are prohibited and considered as illegal, no matter for what purpose they may be held, even for charity, as for instance the Irish Hospital Sweeps. Even in the British concession in Tientsin which comes under British law, the selling by any person or any firm of an Irish Hospital sweep is regarded as illegal and against the law, although hundreds of Irish hospital sweeps are openly sold and bought within the precincts of the British Concession. Sweep tickets are sent to Tientsin from Ireland to firms and individuals, even books of tickets, with a free ticket for anybody who sells, though - strictly and legally speaking it is against the law. One can go to any private club in Tientsin for that matter and play poker, nap, bridge, "beat your neighbour out of doors", or any other card game, and - legally speaking---it is within the law, but to play poker for any monetary stakes among friends, say at one of the local hotels, would be infringing the law, according the British standpoint. Roulette, of course, is tabooed, it is a mechanical game, and therefore is a pure game of chance, with most chances in favour of the "house."

There is certainly a great need for changing the "gambling laws." A little flutter now and again adds a certain amount of filip to one's existence, nothing is said about taking a ten dollar sweep ticket on the "Champions". Everybody does it, Chinese and foreigners alike, it is a big money making proposition for the clubs who issue the tickets, charities benefit by the takings, somebody wins a big prize and the majority lose. But there is never a grouse on the part of those who have tempted fortune, even if they do lose. They will try again next year Sweep tickets are sold wholesale on the Paper Hunts, the Baseball games, in fact any old chance of getting a big return for a small outlay is eagerly indulged in by the optimistic public. But nothing is heard about it, the law does not pounce down upon the sellers of the tickets or those fortunate or unfortunate ones, as the case may be, who try their luck in the hope of amassing a few extra dollars for a small outlay. After all, it is only human nature. But to open a gambling house where the public may assemble and play poker, other card games or roulette---that
pages.zh:
《字林西报》
1932年9月16日，星期五。

通信
何为赌博？

最近在马场路（Racecourse Road）进行的赌博突袭似乎在天津引起了相当大的轰动，尤其是在外籍人士群体中，其中许多人坚持认为此次突袭并无正当理由，涉事场所仅仅是一个私人俱乐部，会员们在此聚首进行安静的扑克牌小戏。

赌博法律不仅在中国，在其他国家（尤其是英国）既复杂又具有弹性。在英国，彩票抽彩（sweepstakes）是被禁止并视为非法的，无论其目的为何，即便是为了慈善，例如爱尔兰医院抽彩（Irish Hospital Sweeps）。即使在受英国法律管辖的天津英租界内，任何个人或商行销售爱尔兰医院抽彩券也被视为非法且违反法律，尽管在英租界范围内有数百张爱尔兰医院抽彩券被公开买卖。抽彩券从爱尔兰寄往天津的各商行和个人，甚至成本的券册，对于任何销售者还附赠免费券，虽然——严格且从法律角度而言——这是违法的。就此事而言，人们可以去天津的任何私人俱乐部玩扑克、拿破仑牌（nap）、桥牌、“beat your neighbour out of doors”或任何其他纸牌游戏，而且——从法律角度而言——这是在法律允许范围内的；但是，如果在当地某家酒店与朋友之间以金钱为注玩扑克，按照英国的观点，则是侵犯法律的行为。轮盘赌当然属于禁忌，它是一种机械游戏，因此是纯粹的碰运气游戏，且大部分几率有利于“庄家”。

确实非常需要修改“赌博法”。偶尔的小试身手能为生活增添几分刺激，没人会对购买一张十美元的“冠军赛”抽彩券说什么。每个人都这样做，无论是中国人还是外国人 alike，这对于发行彩券的俱乐部来说是一项巨大的获利项目，慈善机构也从收入中受益，有人赢得大奖，而大多数人输钱。但是，那些尝试运气的人从未抱怨，即使他们输了。明年他们还会再试。在寻纸游戏（Paper Hunts）、棒球比赛等场合，抽彩券被批量销售，事实上，公众乐观地热衷于任何只需少量支出即可获得巨大回报的机会。但对此无人置喙，法律并未扑向售票者，也未扑向那些试图以小博大、希望积攒几美元额外收入的幸运或不幸者。毕竟，这只是人性使然。但是，开设一家供公众聚集玩扑克、其他纸牌游戏或轮盘赌的赌场——那

pages.en:
is a crime and is punishable by
law. What is the difference be-
tween taking a chance on the
Champions or putting a few paltry
dollars on the red, black or white
in a roulette game? China ponies
are just as elusive and uncertain
as the roulette wheel, but just
because some individual with a
reforming turn of mind decided to
made a law against gambling,
this person or individual suc-
ceeded in getting the rather
stupid law passed. It was evaded
in all kinds of subtle ways,
but those who happened to be
caught paid the penalty.

The most significant part about
the Racecourse Rd. raid is that it
was carried out according to Chinese
law & strict instructions from Nan-
king, we will admit. Yesterday mor-
ning's raid on the gambling house
in Racecourse road, to speak frank-
ly, was a real farce, and the only
redeeming feature about the whole
affair was the fact that the for-
eigners who were caught in the trap
were 'courteously treated', thanks
to the presence of General Ralph
Lulu, a well known and much
respected Chinese resident of Tien-
tsin, who has many foreign friends,
even amongst those whom he was
compelled to arrest, according to
instructions and according to
the law. Some Russians and Chin-
ese were also caught in the "net".
We do not know what is going to
happen, perhaps they will be made
an example of. Whether they will
be fined or imprisoned we do not
know, but in the interest of law
and justice we trust our Chinese
friends and our Russian friends,
who enjoy no extra-territorial rights
will be treated with the same cour-
tesy as afforded these foreigners
enjoying extra-territorial rights
and privileges.

We believe that yesterday morn-
ing's "bag" included quite a num-
ber of respectable and well known
foreign residents of Tientsin, both
military and civilian. They under-
went an unfortunate experience
through the unexpected raid, they
were arrested at the point of the
pistol, bundled into waiting motor
cars and whisked off to police
headquarters, detained there for
several hours while a certain
amount of red tape was gone
through, inconvenienced and annoy-
ed, but finally released on giving
their full names, addresses and
occupation. Beyond that there was
nothing to be really worried about,
neither do we think that any
stigma is attached to their names
because they were unfortunate
enough to be caught in a gambl-
ing house "unofficially" author-
ized while engaged in a quite
human pastime of trying to get
rich with the minimum amount of
outlay.

Gambling is gambling, no matter
in what form, but to try and split
hairs about what form this gambl-
ing should be indulged in, is
farcical to say the least. In
our opinion playing a poker game
---which is a game of "bluff"---
for money, placing ten dollars
on a roulette wheel, or taking
a chance on a China pony in
a sweepstake all comes under
the category of taking a chance or
a flutter to tempt Dame Fortune;
or in the words of the law it is
"gambling." We fully concur with
a certain individual who said that
the law "is an ass" and this
applies to the "Gambling Law"
as well, as it stands at present.

Yours truly,
GAMBLER.
pages.zh:
是一种犯罪，应受法律
制裁。购买“冠军赛”彩券碰运
气，与在轮盘赌中将几枚微
薄的美元押在红色、黑色或白
色上，二者有何区别？中国跑
马（China ponies）就像轮盘
一样难以捉摸且充满不确定
性，但仅仅因为某个具有改革
倾向的个人决定制定反赌博
法，此人便成功推动了这部相
当愚蠢的法律获得通过。人们
以各种微妙的方式规避它，但
那些碰巧被抓到的人付出了代
价。

关于马场路突袭事件最重
要的一点是，它是依据中国法
律及来自南京的严格指令执行
的，我们承认这一点。坦率地
说，昨天早晨对马场路赌场的
突袭简直是一场闹剧，整件事
唯一可取之处在于，落入圈套
的外籍人士受到了“礼貌待
遇”，这多亏了拉尔夫·卢卢
将军（General Ralph Lulu）的
在场。他是天津一位知名且备
受尊敬的中国居民，拥有众多
外籍朋友，甚至包括那些他根
据指令和法律不得不逮捕的
人。一些俄国人和中国人也落
入了“网”中。我们不知道接
下来会发生什么，也许他们会
被杀一儆百。他们会被罚款还
是监禁，我们不得而知，但出
于法律和正义的利益，我们希
望我们的中国朋友和俄国朋友
——他们不享有治外法权——
能受到与享有治外法权和特权
的外籍人士同等的礼貌待遇。

我们相信，昨天早晨的“收
获”中包括相当数量的天津知
名且受人尊敬的外籍居民，包
括军人和平民。由于这次意外
的突袭，他们经历了一次不幸
的遭遇；他们在枪口下被捕，
被塞进等候的汽车，迅速被带
往警察总局，在那里经过一番
繁文缛节后被拘留数小时，虽
然感到不便和恼火，但最终在
提供全名、地址和职业后获
释。除此之外，没有什么真正
值得担心的，我们也认为，由
于他们不幸在一家“非官方”
授权的赌场中被抓，当时他们
正从事一种试图以最小支出发
财的完全符合人性的消遣活
动，他们的名字并不会因此蒙
羞。

赌博就是赌博，无论形式如
何，但试图对这种赌博应以何
种形式进行吹毛求疵，至少可
说是荒谬的。在我们看来，为
金钱玩扑克游戏——这是一种
“虚张声势”的游戏——在轮
盘赌上下注十美元，或在抽彩
中押注中国跑马，都属于碰运
气或小试身手以博取命运女神
青睐的范畴；或者用法律的话
说，这就是“赌博”。我们完
全赞同某位人士的说法，即法
律“是一头蠢驴”，这也适用
于目前的“赌博法”。

此致，
赌徒（GAMBLER）。

pages.en:
North China
Daily Mail.
華北日報
HUA-PEI-JIH-PAO
Friday, September 16th, 1932

The Gambling
Raid

WE cannot say that we are
surprised that the Chin-
ese authorities raided the gambl-
ing house in Racecourse road. It
was only to be expected. Although
it has been in existence only for a
comparatively short period, and
was supposed to have the protec-
tion of the local Chinese authori-
ties in return for a certain sum to
be paid down monthly as “com-
mission” on the takings, sooner or
later the screw would have been
applied, and as subsequent events
have clearly proven the “screw”,
was applied followed by an unex-
pected raid. The “bag” cannot
be said to have been a very big
one, and neither from the finan-
cial point of view was any large
amount of money found on the
premises. It was unfortunate that
some foreigners were caught on
the premises at the time of the
raid, but beyond a visit to the
police station, the taking of names
and addresses and a forced and in-
convenient stay at police head-
quarters the raid was quite a tame
affair. It was carried out in
an orderly and quiet man-
ner—as far as the foreigners were
concerned—and the presence of
General Ralph Lulu, Chief of
Police of the First, Second and
Third Special Areas tended to as-
sure the foreigners that no harm
would come to them.

It was only a few years ago when
Tientsin boasted of several gambl-
ing establishments, some of which
were quite luxurious places, but one
by one they were all closed down by
the Chinese authorities, the last
one to go being the “Louvre”
where the rather childish game of
“lotto” was indulged in. It must
also be borne in mind that when
General Lulu received instructions
from Nanking to make a clean-up
of all gambling dens and other
undesirable haunts, he carried out
his orders to the letter. Therefore,
it was only to be expected that
any person whether foreign or
Chinese, who ignored these orders
would have the law upon them.
The “protection” game is now old
fashioned and cut-of-date. Even
supposing the police officials had
been bribed to allow the gambling
den to be open and run under
police protection or supervision,
the protection soon ceases when
any rift in the lute occurs. In this
particular instance, the raid was
nothing of a sensational nature, so
far no fines were imposed and
nothing taken away from the for-
eigners of a private or personal
nature.

Undoubtedly, the presence of
General Lulu made things much
easier for the foreigners caught in
the raid. It should be a les-
son not to visit gambling houses
in Tientsin, no matter what the
wily proprietors may say about
police “protection” and so forth.
It is all “bunkum.”
pages.zh:
《字林西报》
華北日報
HUA-PEI-JIH-PAO
1932年9月16日，星期五

赌博
突袭

我们不能说我们对中方当局
突袭马场路的赌场感到惊讶。
这是意料之中的事。尽管该赌
场存在时间相对较短，并且据
称每月支付一定金额的营业额
作为“佣金”，从而获得了当
地中国当局的保护，但迟早会
施加压力，正如随后事件清楚
证明的那样，“压力”随之而
来，紧接着是一次意外的突
袭。“收获”不能说很大，从
财务角度来看，现场也没有发
现大量现金。不幸的是，在突
袭发生时，一些外籍人士在现
场被捕，但除了去警察局、登
记姓名和地址以及在警察总局
被迫且不便地停留一段时间
外，这次突袭相当平淡。就外
籍人士而言，突袭是以有序且
安静的方式进行的，第一、二、
三特别区警察局长拉尔夫·卢
卢将军（General Lulu）的在
场，往往使外籍人士确信他们
不会受到伤害。

就在几年前，天津还以拥有
多家赌场为荣，其中一些相当
豪华，但它们都被中国当局逐
一关闭，最后一家被关闭的是
“卢浮宫”（Louvre），那里
盛行着相当幼稚的“乐透”
（lotto）游戏。还必须牢记的
是，当卢卢将军接到南京清理
所有赌博窝点和其他不良场所
的指令时，他严格地执行了命
令。因此，任何人，无论是外
国人还是中国人，如果无视这
些命令，必将受到法律制裁，
这只是意料之中的事。“保护
费”游戏现在已经过时且陈旧
了。即使假设警察官员受贿允
许赌场在警察保护或监督下开
放和运营，一旦出现裂痕，保
护很快就会停止。在这个特定
案例中，突袭没有任何轰动性
质，到目前为止，没有处以罚
款，也没有从外籍人士那里没
收任何私人或个人性质的物
品。

毫无疑问，卢卢将军的在场
使在突袭中被捕的外籍人士的
处境轻松了许多。这应该成为
一个教训：不要光顾天津的赌
场，无论狡猾的业主如何吹嘘
警察“保护”等等。这一切都
是“胡扯”。

pages.en:
NORTH CHINA STAR
TIENTSIN, FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 16, 1932

GAMBLING HOUSE ON
RACE COURSE ROAD
RAIDED BY POLICE

Ten Foreigners And Fifteen
Employees Of House Taken
To Safety Bureau; Chinese
And Two Russians Held In
Custody

Thirty armed police of the
Public Safety Bureau, led by
Major-General Ralph Lulu, gun
in hand, raided a gambling house
on Race Course Road, just beyond
the Villa West Lake, in the early
hours of yesterday morning. Five
dollars Mex. (eighty disappeared
in the excitement), five British,
two Americans, two Russians, one
Spaniard, fifteen Chinese em-
ployees of the House, a roulette
wheel and some chips were the
total result of the raid. There
was only one casualty, one Chi-
nese policeman shot in the leg
with his own gun.

All the persons arrested were
rushed in automobiles along
Victoria Road and Rue de France
to the Police Station after the Bureau
of Public Safety. The foreigners
were kept in the main room
after five minutes waiting Gen-
eral Lulu explained about the
raid. He said he took out
the two Russians while the
Spaniard was allowed to go.
The British and Americans
were kept for an hour or more before
they were permitted to get into
communication with their consular
authorities.

citizen was seated in the next
room, before a Henderson Radio,
perched on top of the ice box,
where refreshments were stored.
Music from a grand opera in
Moscow had just been tuned in
to encourage the guests, not to
play but to buy the machine, which
owing to the difference in time
could not be demonstrated in any
other place opened in the wee
hours of the morning.

Suddenly at 2.20 a.m. the
operatic music was jarred by the
discordant ringing of three bells,
the prearranged signal of alarm
which was quickly followed by a
revolver shot. The American
radio operator shut off his music
and rushed into the main room,
just as General Lulu and his
armed police, all with drawn and
cocked guns, entered the other
door. The foreigners were all
covered and forced at the point
of guns to one side of the room.
One of the Chinese attendants who
was near the table was thoroughly
battered by the police who finally
stopped at the foreigners' pro-
test.

Wheel Located

General Lulu asked for the
wheel which had mysteriously dis-
appeared, but was later found out-
side the window on the verandah.
He then asked for the money but
the drawer containing it had also
disappeared. When it was final-
ly recovered it contained only five
dollars Mex. The Spanish man-
ager explained that they did not
keep much cash, but paid win-
nings by check. He explained
that there should have been
eighty-five dollars in the drawer
and declared that the police had
taken the eighty that was miss-
ing. General Lulu then said that
the manager must open the safe,
but the manager explained that
they had no safe in the house and
a search by the police showed this
to be a fact.

In the early part of the ex-
citement the wounded policeman
was brought in and placed in a
chair. At first nobody paid much
attention to him, but later an
argument ensued as to how he was
shot. The foreigners declared that
he stumbled and shot himself. He
first said that one of the Russians
beat him in the face and he shot
himself in the leg. Later he
claimed that one of the foreigners
pushed his gun down and it went
off. All agreed that he was shot
by his own gun.

Lady Not Arrested

When the shot was fired a lady,
who was sleeping on the floor
above sprang from her bed and
locked her door. The police broke
through it and ordered her to put
on her clothes and come down. The
lady flatly refused and stuck to
her bed. Finally the police went
off and left her there.

In the meantime the foreigners
vehemently protested against their
arrest and demanded to phone
their various consular authorities.
But the police absolutely refused
and kept them covered with guns
of half a dozen different kinds
and calibres. One of the foreign-
ers who knew General Lulu rather
well stepped forward to talk to
him but the gun of a policeman
pushed him back.

General Lulu explained that
the gambling house was not in his
Special Area and that he had just
been called in to assist the City
Police. He added that the foreign-
ers should "be glad he was there."
He told the party as they were
all loaded into motor cars and
taken with armed guards on the
running boards to the Bureau of
Public Safety. Here they were
kept for an hour or more before
they were permitted to get into
communication with their consular
authorities.

Released For Arms

They were asked to sign state-
ments that the police had not
molested them bodily but they flat-
ly refused, although each one gave
his name, address and nationality.
They were searched for arms by
the police when they were first
arrested but nothing was taken
from them. They were not al-
lowed water or anything else to
drink. Although some of them by
a simple verbal order could ordi-
narily dispose of millions of
dollars, they were kept in the
Bureau of Public Safety until
the Chief of Police personally
offered his pack of smokes which
was at once exhausted.

All of the Chinese employees
were taken to the Bureau of Public
Safety, except the cook who, the
foreigners say, was left to cook
for the policemen who remained
on guard at the house. Some of
the foreigners declared that the
gambling house, which had been
running for about six weeks, had
been given permission to operate
in the area because it is located
and that only two days before the
raid somebody had told them
Festival had been held.

China All Safe

《华北星报》
天津，1932年9月16日，星期五

跑马厅路赌场
遭警方突袭

十名外国人及十五名
赌场雇员被带往公安局；
中国人及两名俄国人
被拘留

昨日凌晨，公共安全局三十名武装警察在拉尔夫·卢鲁（Ralph Lulu）少将的率领下，手持枪支，突袭了位于西湖别墅（Villa West Lake）外侧不远处的跑马厅路（Race Course Road）上的一家赌场。此次行动的总收获为：五元墨西哥鹰洋（另有八十元在混乱中失踪）、五名英国人、两名美国人、两名俄国人、一名西班牙人、十五名该赌场的中国雇员、一个轮盘赌轮及一些筹码。仅有一人受伤，即一名中国警察被自己的枪击中腿部。

所有被捕人员随后经维多利亚路（Victoria Road）和法租界公馆马路（Rue de France），由汽车迅速押送至公安局。外国人在主厅等候了五分钟，期间卢鲁将军解释了突袭行动。他表示已将两名俄国人带出，而允许那名西班牙人离开。英国人和美国人在被允许与其领事当局联系之前，被扣留了一个多小时。

一位公民坐在隔壁房间，面前是一台亨德森（Henderson）收音机，该机放置在存放茶点的冰箱顶部。此时刚调谐到莫斯科的一部大歌剧音乐，旨在鼓励客人们——不是去赌博，而是购买这台机器，由于时差关系，这种演示无法在其他任何在清晨时分开放的场所进行。

突然，在凌晨2点20分，歌剧音乐被三声铃响的不和谐声音打断，这是预先约定的警报信号，紧接着便是一声左轮手枪的枪响。美国籍无线电操作员关闭了音乐，冲进主厅，就在此时，卢鲁将军及其武装警察从另一扇门进入，所有人均拔枪并处于待击发状态。所有外国人均被枪口指住，并被强迫移至房间的一侧。一名靠近桌子的中国侍者遭到警察的猛烈殴打，直到外国人提出抗议后才停止。

找到轮盘

卢鲁将军要求交出神秘消失的轮盘，但后来在阳台窗外的外面找到了它。随后他要求交出现金，但装有现金的抽屉也不见了。当最终找回该抽屉时，里面仅有五元墨西哥鹰洋。那位西班牙经理解释说，他们不保留大量现金，而是通过支票支付赢利。他解释说抽屉里本应有八十五美元，并声称警察拿走了失踪的那八十元。卢鲁将军随即表示经理必须打开保险箱，但经理解释说屋内没有保险箱，警方的搜查证实了这一事实。

在骚乱初期，受伤的警察被抬进来并安置在椅子上。起初没人太注意他，但后来就他是如何中枪的问题发生了争论。外国人声称是他自己绊倒后走火自伤。他最初说是一名俄国人打了他的脸，导致他开枪击中了自己的腿。后来他又声称是一名外国人将他的枪向下推，导致走火。所有人都同意他是被自己的枪击中的。

女士未被捕

枪响时，一位睡在楼上的女士从床上跳起并锁上了房门。警察破门而入，命令她穿上衣服下楼。该女士断然拒绝，坚持留在床上。最终警察离去，将她留在那里。

与此同时，外国人强烈抗议他们的逮捕，并要求打电话给各自的领事当局。但警察断然拒绝，并用半打不同种类和口径的枪支指着他们。其中一名与卢鲁将军相当熟识的外国人上前试图与他交谈，但被一名警察用枪逼退。

卢鲁将军解释说，该赌场不在他的特别区管辖范围内，他只是应召协助城市警察。他补充说，外国人应该“庆幸他在那里”。当所有人被装上汽车，并由站在踏板上的武装警卫押送至公安局时，他对这群人如此说道。在这里，他们在被允许与其领事当局联系之前，又被扣留了一个多小时。

因武器问题获释

他们被要求签署声明，称警察未对他们进行身体侵犯，但他们断然拒绝，尽管每个人都提供了姓名、地址和国籍。他们在最初被捕时曾被警察搜身检查武器，但未从他们身上拿走任何东西。他们不被允许喝水或饮用其他任何饮料。尽管他们中的一些人通常只需简单的口头命令即可支配数百万美元，但他们被关在公安局，直到警察局长亲自递上他的香烟包，且香烟立刻被抽完。

除厨师外，所有中国雇员均被带往公安局，据外国人说，厨师被留下为留守在该处警戒的警察做饭。一些外国人宣称，这家已运营约六周的赌场之所以被允许在该区域经营，是因为其地理位置，且在突袭前两天还有人告诉他们曾举行过节庆活动。

中国一切安全

NORTH CHINA STAR

TIENTSIN, THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 15, 1932

MAJOR-GENERAL LULU
RESUMES HIS DUTIES
IN SPECIAL AREAS

Major-Gen. Lulu

Major-General Ralph Lulu, who headed the 1,150 Peiping special police and proceeded to Shanghai last spring to take over the areas evacuated by the Japanese troops following the Sino-Japanese conflict in that city, has returned to Tientsin. General Lulu had been indisposed for the past few days and was able only yesterday to resume his duties as Commissioner of the First, Third and Fourth Special Areas.
The General expressed satisfaction that there had been no difficulty in taking over the territory from the hands of the Japanese, and also voiced appreciation for the assistance accorded him by the police authorities of the International Settlement and French Concession of Shanghai.
The Peiping special police patrolled in the evacuated areas during the past three months. Later a portion of the force was reorganized and combined with the Chinese municipal police of Shanghai. The remainder, numbering over six hundred men, have returned to the north. The Chinese authorities in Tientsin and Peiping are endeavoring to secure some work for these six hundred men.
General Lulu will now stay in Tientsin permanently and will devote his entire time in the administrative affairs of the three special areas.

Gen. Lulu Puzzled

One fact which puzzled the public as well as General Lulu himself is that immediately after his departure from Shanghai, the vernacular press of that port printed an article that Lulu, accompanied by six hundred of the Peiping special police, had returned to the north. The next day, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai approached the newspapers concerned and asked for a correction to be made to the effect that General Lulu did not return to the north but was on temporary leave of absence. As General Lulu is not connected with the Shanghai Municipality it was unnecessary to obtain leave of absence from the municipal authorities.

re General Lulu

《华北星报》

天津，1932年9月15日，星期四

卢鲁少将
恢复其在特别区的职务

卢鲁少将

拉尔夫·卢鲁（Ralph Lulu）少将曾统领1150名北平特别警察，并于去年春季前往上海，接管中日冲突后日军撤离的区域，现已返回天津。卢鲁将军过去几天身体不适，直到昨日才得以恢复其第一、第三和第四特别区专员的职务。
将军表示满意的是，从日本人手中接管领土并未遇到困难，并对上海公共租界和法租界警察当局给予他的协助表示感谢。
北平特别警察在过去三个月中巡逻了撤离区域。随后，部分部队进行了重组，并与上海市的中国市政警察合并。其余六百多人已返回北方。天津和北平的中国当局正努力为这六百人谋求一些工作。
卢鲁将军现在将永久驻留天津，并将全部时间致力于这三个特别区的行政事务。

卢鲁将军感到困惑

令公众以及卢鲁将军本人感到困惑的一个事实是，在他离开上海后不久，该港口的中文报纸刊登了一篇文章，称卢鲁在六百名北平特别警察的陪同下已返回北方。次日，大上海市政府接触相关报社，要求更正，称卢鲁将军并未返回北方，而是暂时休假。由于卢鲁将军与大上海市政府无隶属关系，因此无需向市政当局请假。

登记员注：关于卢鲁将军的文件请附后
JH
1932年9月23日

Translation of Despatch No. 3 to Council

Shanghai.
Dated 25th August, 1932.

Pao An Ch'u: Vigilance Department.

We have received the following instructions from the
Municipal Government of Greater Shanghai, (Order 2103):-
"Following telegram received from the Executive Yuan :
'The regulations governing the Pao An Ch'u (Vigilance
Department) have been noted. The Pao An Ch'u was
instituted in Kiangsu, Chekiang, and Kiangsi with the
sanction of the now defunct Headquarters of the Army,
Navy and Air Force Commanders-in-Chief. Following
precedents, the regulations were submitted to the
Military Affairs Commission for consideration; they
have now been approved, and you are hereby notified
by wire.'
Copy of Regulations enclosed. You are directed to organize
the Pao An Ch'u without delay and to report on the matter."
With the Order was enclosed a copy of the Regulations.
On the same date Order No. 2127 was received:
"An official seal bearing the inscription 'Seal of Pao An
Ch'u, Municipality of Greater Shanghai (上海市保安處關防)'
and ivory chop with the characters 'Chief of Pao An Ch'u,
Municipality of Greater Shanghai' (上海市保安處處長)
and two ivory chops for the Deputy Chiefs, bearing the
characters 'Deputy Chief of Pao An Ch'u, Municipality of
Greater Shanghai (上海市保安處副處長) have been engraved
and are hereby issued to the Pao An Ch'u for use."
The above-mentioned official seal of wood and three
ivory chops have been received. In pursuance of the above-quoted
orders, the Pao An Ch'u was inaugurated on the 18th instant. The
seal and chops are in use. Please take note.

Wu Teh-cheng,
Concurrently Chief of Pao An Ch'u.

Subject (in full) Peace Preservation Corps

Made by D.I. Sin Tse-liang Forwarded by The Robertson, Supt.

Col. Huang Ming, Commander of the 1st Infantry Regiment of the Peace Preservation Corps, who has already submitted resignation to Mayor Wu Teh-chen, has not attended his office in Chapei for the last three days, and Li Pah-long (李白郎 ), Vice Commander of the 1st Regiment, is now officiating in his place.

Major Kwan Kung, Commander of the 1st Battalion of the 1st Regiment, who, it is reported has been at variance with Col. Huang Ming, has been transferred by the order of Mayor Wu to be the Vice Commander of 2nd Infantry Regiment.

It is reported that the ill-feeling between Col. Huang and Major Kwan originated from the latter's direct application sometime ago to the Mayor Wu, who is Kwan's relative, for an officer to be appointed as the Commander of the 2nd Company of his Battalion. Kwan's failure to report the vacancy of this post to Col. Huang Ming, his immediate superior, has so enraged the latter that during a conference Major Kwan was severely reprimanded by Col. Huang. Subsequent to this incident, Major Kwan was transferred and on August 13, a secret order was received by Col. Huang from Mayor Wu instructing him to put under arrest the following officers :-

Commanders of the 3rd & 4th Companies, 1st Battalion,
Vice Commanders of the 1st and 2nd Companies,
1st Battalion.

This order was instantly carried out and these four officers are still detained in the Regimental Headquarters, Chapei, although no charge has been

保安队第一步兵团团长黄明上校已向吴铁城市长提交辞呈，过去三天未前往其在闸北的办公室办公，目前由该团副团长李白郎（Li Pah-long）代理其职。

据悉，第一步兵团第一营营长关公（Kwan Kung）少校与黄明上校不和，现奉吴市长命令调任第二步兵团副团长。

据报，黄上校与关少校之间的嫌隙源于后者不久前直接向吴市长申请为其营第二连任命一名连长，而吴市长是关的亲戚。关未向其直属上级黄明上校汇报该职位的空缺，致使黄大怒，并在一次会议中严厉斥责了关少校。此事发生后，关被调职，且黄上校于8月13日收到吴市长的一道密令，指示其逮捕以下军官：

第一营第三、第四连连长，
第一营第一、第二连副连长。

该命令已立即执行，这四名军官目前仍被拘禁在闸北的团部，尽管尚未对他们提出任何指控。

It is reported that non-commissioned members of the

reduce the sum to $13.50 and $15.00 which is even less than
the wages of the constables of the Public Safety Bureau.
Consequently a rumour is rife among the members of the Corps,
particularly those formerly belonging to the Peiping
constabulary, that as soon as this order is formally adopted,
the majority of their number would resign. In order to
prevent sudden disorder, the issue of wages has been withheld
pending some new arrangement to ameliorate the situation.
It is reported that Col. Huang Ming, Commander of
the 1st Infantry Regiment of the Peace Preservation Corps
and Major Kwan Kung, Commander of the 1st Battalion of the
Regiment have both recently submitted their resignation from
their respective posts to Mayor Wu Teh-chen. This is said
to be the outcome of bad feeling between these two officers
and it is further reported that the latter named, who is
a relative of Mayor Wu, is arrogant and insubordinate to
Col. Huang Ming, his immediate superior.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

Subject (in full) Arrival of members of the Peace Maintenance Corps & billeted
at a Chinese Temple off Amherst Road, O.O.L.

Made by S.I. Dalgetty Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

I beg to report that at 9.30 a.m. 3-8-32, P/S.336 McArdle
(M/cycle patrol) came to the station and reported that Chinese
soldiers were billeted at a Chinese Temple situate off Amherst
Road O.O.L. Enquiries were made by the undersigned and ascertained
that 150 men in uniform, known as "Peace Maintenance Corps" and
armed with rifles and bombs, in charge of Captain Sung arrived from
Sungkiang on the 3-8-32 on instructions received from the Munici-
pality of Greater Shanghai. So far they have received no
instructions as to their objective in Shanghai, but from what I
could gather they are to be posted as guards on the outlying roads
for the purpose of keeping good order. At present they maintain
an armed guard consisting of two men at the entrance of the
Temple doorway. Capt. Sung states that a further 100 men of the
same Corps armed with machine guns will arrive in a few days
from Sungkiang.

Further enquiries are being made to ascertain their object
in coming to Shanghai.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Subject (in full) Paoantui or Peace Preservation Bureau

Made by D.I. Sih Tsz-liang Forwarded by Tho Rubertan Lufi

Following the withdrawal of Japanese troops from
Chapei, a Peace Preservation Bureau was organized by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai on July 5 and with
Mayor Wu Tieh-chen and General Wen Ying-sing, Chief of
the Public Safety Bureau as the Chief and Deputy-Chief
respectively, with the ostensible object of garrisoning
the Shanghai area. This Bureau will control a unit
to be known as "Shanghai Municipality Peace Preservation
Corp" which will be composed of two Regiments to be known
as Infantry Regiments, each of which will consist of
3,000 men.

According to the project under contemplation this
corps will not only consist of Infantry but also will
embody a motor cycle company, cavalry, a tank corps,
communication corps and a medical section.

The 1st Infantry Regiment has been formally
organized. The Chief is Colonel Huang Ming. It
consists of three Battalions. Each Battalion is divided
into four companies with 124 policemen in each company.
The 1st Battalion is composed of members of the Reserve
Unit of Public Safety Bureau, the 2nd Battalion is
composed of the Peiping Policemen and the 3rd Battalion
is still in the process of organization although the
Commander Kiang Shing-tao (江聲濤) has been appointed.

With reference to the 2nd Infantry Regiment, it
is learned that it will be organized out of the 6th
Regiment of Military Police which has returned to
Sungkiang from its Bandit Suppression Campaign in
Kiangpeh. It is not known yet, however, when this

WHAT IS PAOANTUI ?

SHANGHAI, JULY 15.

THE SO CALLED PAOANTUI OR PEACE PRESERVATION
CORPS, WHICH HAS BEEN ORGANIZED RECENTLY FOR THE OSTEN-
SIBLE OBJECT OF PRESERVING THE ORDER IN THE AREA
EVACUATED BY THE JAPANESE MARINES, IS COMPOSED OF
ONE REGIMENT OF FULLY ARMED SOLDIERS, DIVIDED INTO
THREE BATTALIONS. THE CHIEF OF THE PAOANTUI IS
COLONEL HUANG MING.

THE MEMBERS OF THE CORPS ARE NOT ONLY
EQUIPPED WITH RIFLES, MACHINE GUNS AND OTHER REGULAR
WEAPONS OF SOLDIERS BUT THEY ALSO POSSESS TANK CORPS,
COMMUNICATION CORPS AND MEDICAL SECTION. IN ADDITION,
THE PAOANTUI HAS ITS OWN TRAINING CORPS WHICH ARE
TO GIVE MILITARY TRAINING TO CANDIDATES TO MEMBERS
OF THE CORPS. IT IS SAID THAT THE CHINESE AUTHORITIES
ARE PLANNING TO INCREASE THE NUMBER OF THESE PAOANTUI
MEN TO AS MANY AS 6,000 IN THE NEAR FUTURE. - PRESS
UNION.

什么是保安队？

上海，7月15日。

所谓保安队或治安维持团，是最近为维持日本海军陆战队撤离地区的秩序这一表面目的而组建的，由一个全副武装的士兵组成的团构成，分为三个营。保安队的负责人是黄明上校。

该团成员不仅配备步枪、机枪和其他常规士兵武器，还拥有坦克部队、通信部队和医务部门。此外，保安队有自己的训练队，旨在为该团候选成员提供军事训练。据说中国当局计划在不久的将来将这些保安队人员增加到多达6,000人。——合众社。

（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY Sinza Police Station, D 3648. Date May 17th, 1932 18/5/32.）

Subject (in full) Public Safety Bureau again policing Chapei

Made by and ............................................................ Forwarded by Inspector Robertson.

Sir,

I beg to report that at about 7.30 A.M. May 16 P.S. Aston
on duty at Markham Road Bridge telephoned the Station reporting
10 motor furniture vans containing armed Chinese Police in full
uniform and equipment had crossed the Bridge from the Settlement
into Chapei and that there was no Settlement Police escort
accompanying them.

From subsequent enquiries it was learned they had come
from Nantao and entered the Settlement at Avenue Foch and Yates
Road from French Town and arrived at the Bridge via Yates and
Carter Roads.

They had been instructed to proceed via Thibet Road,
according to an officer in charge of them named Mr. Li, but,
owing to the guides not being very well acquainted with the
Settlement they had made a mistake and taken the above route
instead. Two more trips were made during the forenoon by the
same route under foreign police escorts supplied from Sinza
to and from French Town and 300 men and their equipment
transported across on each trip making a total of 900 altogether.

These men have now taken over the policing of Chapei from
the Japanese Marines, the latter withdrawing their men from
their posts on the Bridges in this District at about 8 A.M.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

W R Robertson
Inspector.

（批：D.C. (Divl.) Information. If true, it shows a lack of friendly feeling.）

先生，

谨此报告，5月16日上午约7时30分，在马克姆路（Markham Road，即麦根路）桥值勤的阿斯顿（Aston）警员致电本捕房报告称，10辆载有全副武装、身着制服并配备装备的中国警察的机动家具货车，已从租界过桥进入闸北，且并无租界巡捕随行护送。

Extract from Intelligence Report 17.5.32.

Chapei - administration partially restored to Chinese Authorities.

In conformity with arrangements made, seven hundred and fifty policemen of the Public Safety Bureau took over at 9 a.m. May 16 the administration of the area in Chapei (Vide I.R. 15/5/32) evacuated by the Japanese troops. Huang Ming, Officer-in-charge of the Reserve Unit of the Public Safety Bureau, accompanied by other Chinese representatives called at the Headquarters of the 5th Company of the Japanese Marines on Kung Wu Road, formerly used as the Police Training Depot.
Having handed over all document to the callers and obtained a receipt therefor, the Japanese marines, about 200 in number, left the area and proceeded eastward. Thereupon, the Chinese Authorities took over all posts, stationing one Peiping policeman and one local constable, each armed with a rifle, at all traffic points. These are assisted by four motor cycle patrols each consisting of 3 Chinese policemen armed with Mauser pistols. Martial Law was declared between 6.30 p.m. and 4 a.m. on May 16/17.

As a temporary measure, the following offices have been established by the Shanghai Municipality :-

Chapei- partial evacuation by Japanese military and
resumption of administration by Municipality of Greater
Shanghai

The Joint Commission has notified General Wen, Chief
of the Bureau of Public Safety that the Japanese forces
will on May 16 evacuate that portion of Chapei bounded
by the railway line on the north, by Soochow Creek on the
west and south and on the east by a line formed by the
Chapei-Settlement Boundary from Soochow Creek to Haining
Road extension and continuing direct North to the railway
line. The Bureau of Public Safety propose to police
this area with 750 men. The small pocket east of this
area will continue to be under Japanese jurisdiction
for the time being as also will the railway line including
the Station and the area north thereof.

Made by D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

It is reported that the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai has made the following arrangements for the taking
over of Chapei following the evacuation by Japanese troops:
1. The Public Health Bureau will send 100 road cleaners to
Chapei on May 17 to attend to the road cleaning in
Chapei area.
2. The Bureau of Social Affairs is arranging to re-establish
People's
a "Poor/Loan Office" in Chapei with a capital of $10,000
for the relief of poor people.
3. The Public Safety Bureau will start a movement to under-
take the following:-
a) Taking a census.
b) Prohibiting erection of mud-huts and repatriating all
unemployed workers to their native place.
c) Searching for arms and ammunition.
4. The Bureau of Public Works will attend to removing
barricades and other defence works as well as filling
up holes in ground.
5. The Land Bureau will attend to registering of title
deeds and Fang-Tan in Chapei with a view to checking
the missing or loss.
6. The Shanghai Telephone Administration is now repairing
the apperatus and machines in the Chapei office at
Tatung Road, as well as the trunk line to Quinsan.
Efforts are firstly being made to restore the private
lines connecting official organizations. The estimated
loss suffered by the Company in Chapei is about $200,000.
7. The Bureau of Education is now inspecting the war effect-
ed zone in Chapei in order to ascertain the extent of

May 5, 1932

China Evening News:-

The Policing of Chapei.

As the Sino-Japanese peace agreement will be
signed soon, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has issued an
order to the Public Safety Bureau directing it to make preparations
to police Chapei. Wang Ts Ching, Chief of the Second Department of
the Bureau, and other officers have been appointed as duties to under-
take this work. A telegram has been sent to Peiping requesting that
the 500 policemen already selected be sent to Shanghai within 2 weeks.

Col. Wen Ying Sing, Chief of the Public Safety
Bureau, has secured permission from Mayor Wu Te Chen to remit to
Peiping one month's pay in advance to these 500 policemen and a sum
of $2,000 as passage money.

闸北的警务工作。

随着中日和平协定即将签署，大上海市政府已向公安局发布命令，指示其做好接管闸北警务的准备工作。该局第二科科长王竹卿及其他官员已被任命负责此项工作。已向北平发出电报，要求已在选拔中的500名警察在两周内派往上海。

公安局局长温应星上校已获得市长吴铁城的许可，向这500名警察预付一个月薪俸，并发放2,000元作为路费。

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, MAY 3, 1932

Peiping Police
For War - Torn
Areas Due Soon

1,000 Due This Week
To Police Chapei
And Woosung

Expert Peiping police, numbering more than 1,000, are expected here this week to join the police force of the Bureau of Public Safety when that body regains its authority in Chapei, Woosung and Kiangwan after Japanese troops have withdrawn.

The Peiping "cops," according to bureau officers, are better equipped than the Shanghai constables and their strength will greatly facilitate policing duties in those areas.

Besides other preparations required for taking up its duties in the three areas, the bureau will petition Mayor Wu Te-chen of Greater Shanghai, to make representations to Japanese authorities for an earlier date for the carrying out of the agreement.

Investigators sent out by the bureau to Chapei, Woosung and Kiangwan submitted their reports to bureau on conditions of the various police stations in those areas yesterday. The Chapei investigators reported that the 5th Divisional Police Station, largest Chinese police station in Chapei was destroyed while the 4th and 7th stations have sustained little damage.

They said that Japanese troops were not much in evidence, and while they still occupy the Chenju station, they have vacated other stations.

The 5th and 7th Divisional stations in Woosung and Kiangwan and their branches were reported to have been burned down. New buildings will either be erected or rented by the bureau.

《字林西报》，1932年5月3日，星期二

北平警察
即将抵达
战区

本周将有1,000人
负责闸北
和吴淞的警务

据预期，超过1,000名经验丰富的北平警察将于本周抵达此处，加入公安局的警力队伍，待日军撤出后，该机构将在闸北、吴淞和江湾恢复职权。

据该局官员称，这些北平“警察”装备优于上海巡捕，他们的加入将极大地便利这些地区的警务工作。

除了为在这三个地区履行职责所需的其他准备工作外，该局还将向大上海市长吴铁城请愿，向日本当局交涉，争取更早执行协定。

该局派往闸北、吴淞和江湾的调查人员昨日向该局提交了关于这些地区各警察局状况的报告。闸北调查人员报告称，闸北最大的中国警察局——第五区警察分局已被摧毁，而第四和第七分局受损轻微。

他们说，日军踪迹不多，虽然他们仍占据陈局（音译）派出所，但已撤离其他派出所。

据报道，吴淞和江湾的第五和第七区分局及其分所已被烧毁。该局将要么新建建筑，要么租赁房屋。

THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, MAY 1, 1932

Bureau Of Public
Safety Conducts
Survey Of Chapei

Accord Reached Recently
Between Japanese
And Mayor Wu

A preliminary investigation into
the conditions of Chinese police
stations in Chapei, Woosung, and
Kiangwan as the first step towards
the actual resumption of patrolling
duties in those areas by Chinese
police was conducted yesterday by
10 members of Bureau of Public
Safety.

The investigators are expected to
turn in their reports to General
Wen Ying-hsing, head of the bu-
reau today. The Police Duties Re-
sumption Committee which consists
of Mr. Feng Su-lang, secretary of
the bureau, Mr. Lu Ting, head of
detective department and three
other department heads will make
a careful study on the subjects of
how to best rebuild police stations
demolished by fire, and other mat-
ters pertaining to the policing of
those areas.

Interviewed yesterday by a China
Press representative Mr. Feng Su-
lang, secretary of the bureau said
that there has been an understand-
ing between Mayor Wu Teh-chen
and Japanese authorities on the
matter some time ago, but the com-
mittee ordered by him only met on
April 30. Several important re-
solutions were reached.

Reorganization First Step

The chief problems confronting
the committee, it was stated, are
those pertaining to finance and re-
organization of the police in the
devastated areas. There were before
the war 18 divisional police stations
in the three areas and each of these
needs approximately $3,000 for re-
pair. Expense for their equipment
were said to be high and hard to
figure out unless investigators can
do the job with care.

Conscription of new policemen
was said to be another problem.
Formerly the bureau had 1,700 men
in Chapei, Woosung and Kiang-
wan, but half of them are missing.
Their disappearance may consti-
tute a danger to the city in view
of the fact that they possess guns.
The bureau, however, is trying to
collect these guns and will re-admit
these policemen to its service if
they return with guns.

To Use Japanese Policemen

The idea of the 5th Division of
Chinese Police in Chapei will be
changed. Wang Hsin-fu, head
of the second department of the
bureau was recommended but the
final decision rests with General
Wen Ying-hsing.

Japanese interpreters will be tem-
porarily hired by the police divi-
sions in Chapei, Woosung, and
Kiangwan under whom the bureau
will operate. It is understood that
local magistrates with Japanese
may recommend such appointment
it was said.

SI,
For verification and
report early please.
JAS

《字林西报》，1932年5月1日，星期日

公安局
进行
闸北调查

近期达成协定
介于日本方面
与吴市长之间

作为中国警察实际恢复在这些地区巡逻职责的第一步，公安局的10名成员昨日对闸北、吴淞和江湾的中国警察局状况进行了初步调查。

预计调查人员将于今日向局局长温应星将军提交报告。由该局秘书冯淑兰先生、探长卢廷先生和其他三位部门主管组成的警务恢复委员会，将仔细研究如何最佳重建被火焚毁的警察局，以及与这些地区警务有关的其他事项。

该局秘书冯淑兰先生昨日在接受《字林西报》代表采访时说，吴铁城市长与日本当局在此事上早已达成谅解，但他下令成立的委员会直到4月30日才召开会议。会议达成了几项重要决议。

重组是第一步

据悉，委员会面临的主要问题是受灾地区的财政和警察重组问题。战前这三个地区共有18个区警察分局，每个分局大约需要3,000元进行维修。据说其装备费用高昂且难以估算，除非调查人员仔细开展工作。

据说征募新警察是另一个问题。以前该局在闸北、吴淞和江湾有1,700人，但其中一半失踪。鉴于他们拥有枪支，他们的失踪可能对城市构成危险。然而，该局正试图收缴这些枪支，如果这些警察携枪归来，该局将重新录用他们。

将使用日本警察

闸北中国警察第五科的构想将有所改变。曾推荐该局第二科科长王新甫担任负责人，但最终决定权在于温应星将军。

据悉，闸北、吴淞和江湾的警察科将临时雇佣日语翻译，该局将在其协助下运作。据说，当地懂日语的地方官可能会推荐此类任命。

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, MARCH 29, 1932

PEIPING POLICE
COMING HERE

500 Northerners Are Ordered
Selected For Shanghai

PEIPING, March 28.—(Reuters).—The excellent reputation they have long enjoyed promises to get yet another job for the Peiping police. The Ministry of Home Affairs has sent instructions to the local Bureau of Public Safety to select 500 Peiping police for service in the Shanghai area.

The ministry says that when Japanese forces evacuate the areas they now hold police will be needed to maintain order and that as the police of this city are generally considered the best in the country 500 of them must be drafted southwards.

In compliance with this instruction the bureau is selecting 10 commissioned officers, 30 sergeants and 460 constables for service in Shanghai.

It will be recalled that after the capture of Peiping by the Nationalists in 1928 a large body of Peiping police was drafted southwards to take over the policing of the new capital, Nanking.

《字林西报》，1932年3月29日，星期二

北平警察
即将来沪

五百名北方人员奉命
遴选赴上海

北平，3月28日.—（路透社电）.— 北平警察长期以来享有的良好声誉，预示着他们将再次获得一项任务。内政部已向当地公安局发出指令，遴选500名北平警察前往上海地区服役。

该部表示，当日军撤离其目前占领的地区时，需要警察来维持秩序；鉴于本市警察普遍被认为是全国最优秀的，必须抽调其中500人南下。

为执行此项指令，该局正在遴选10名委任警官、30名警长和460名警员，以赴上海服役。

值得回顾的是，1928年国民党军队攻占北平后，曾大批抽调北平警察南下，接管新首都南京的警务工作。
